name: @tedix/os
description: Tedix OS, the product web application: conversations, workers, apps, skills, work management, and administration.

scripts.dev: bun run clear-port && bun run dev:fixtures
scripts.dev:local-demo: bun run clear-port && bun run dev:fixtures
scripts.build:local: TEDIX_LOCAL_COMPATIBILITY_DATE=2026-08-11 TEDIX_OS_LOCAL_DEV=1 bun ../../scripts/dev-local.ts -- vp build --mode development
scripts.deploy:production: vp build --mode production && cf deploy --mode production --prebuilt --message ${GIT_SHA:-${GITHUB_SHA:-unknown}}
scripts.test:run: bun run test:unit && bun run test:workerd && bun run test:browser:avatars && bun run test:browser:dialogs && bun run test:browser:deck && bun run test:browser:feed-deck && bun run test:browser:viewport && bun run test:browser:members && bun run test:browser:shell && bun run test:browser:social-cards && bun run test:browser:chat-list && bun run test:browser:chat-actions && bun run test:browser:state-gallery && bun run test:browser:memory && bun run test:browser:outputs && bun run test:browser:tedis && bun run test:browser:work-iphone
scripts.test:browser:outputs: bun browser-tests/outputs.spec.ts && bun browser-tests/b8-outputs-iphone.spec.ts && bun browser-tests/b9-export-phone.spec.ts && bun browser-tests/b9-editor-toolbar.spec.ts
scripts.test:browser:viewport: bun browser-tests/deck-viewport.spec.ts && bun browser-tests/deck-responsive.spec.ts && bun browser-tests/viewport-band.spec.ts && bun browser-tests/deck-iphone.spec.ts
scripts.test:browser:deck: bun browser-tests/deck.spec.ts && bun browser-tests/deck-progress.spec.ts && bun browser-tests/deck-webmcp.spec.ts && bun browser-tests/deck-why-chain.spec.ts && bun browser-tests/card-text-dates.spec.ts && bun browser-tests/deck-chat.spec.ts
scripts.test:ci: bun run test:run && bun run test:browser:apps && bun run test:browser:focus-clip
